themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents specifically designed to assist with or perform research tasks, including autonomous research agents and agentic workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often acting as programming partners.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about AI-powered platforms, software, and tools designed to enhance or automate various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on the application of AI in testing the usability of products and services, including automated checks and AI-driven feedback.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial user representations or 'digital twins' for testing, research, or simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is integrated into the design process and general research activities, including AI for ideation and prototyping.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze customer data and behavior to derive actionable insights for product development and marketing.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Content detailing the research and development surrounding AI-powered chatbots, their interactions, accuracy, and impact on users.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI in the recruitment process, including AI's impact on job roles, hiring tools, and candidate selection.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing interview transcripts or understanding user sentiment from free-text data.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
